name: BroadbandSpeedComplaintTester
tagline: Record line tests, prove whether the minimum guaranteed speed is met and manage remedy periods and penalty-free exits – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete broadband speed complaint app for Power Apps and Power Pages: line test history against the minimum guaranteed speed promised at sale, an assessed speed (median of the last tests) with clear verdicts, a remedy period countdown, engineer visits with retest prompts, penalty-free exit rights, outcomes and retention. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and binds to any complaint table in a few clicks.
features: 10 clickable KPIs: open complaints, below guarantee, remedies ending soon, exit rights due, average speed vs MGS, retention, credits
Assessed speed = median of the last N tests with verdicts Below MGS / Borderline / Meets guarantee / More tests needed
Speed gauge and test history chart against the MGS and the estimate at sale
Record line tests (download, upload, peak / off-peak) with validation and next-step suggestions
Remedy period countdown with warning window and exit rights due
Workflow rules: tests required before confirming or resolving, engineer visit date and owner, exit only after the remedy period, outcome on close
Drag and drop remedy board with allowed / not-allowed feedback and a keyboard Move menu
Bulk start tests, owner and fault cause assignment, CSV export, undo and automatic audit notes
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen reader support
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
